notes: Single-stage module+CLI deliverable: parse two CSV transport ledgers (comma- or whitespace-separated, blank lines ignored), validate shapes, take the dot product, root-clamp to non-negative, and return the square root as the metric distance. Nonzero rubric for reasoning_depth (two interfaces + CSV parsing), debugging_ambiguity (unrooted-squared-cost is the classic trap; must root and clamp, and surface errors as ValueError/exit 1 without tracebacks), adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization (negative clamp, zero plan, transposed mismatch, ragged, tiny magnitudes, rectangular, int/float mix), and quantitative_correctness (float distance compared to independently recomputed values). No dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
